kiln

00themes

One look for every tool.Pick a sky; everything follows.

Each theme is one small file with a dark and a light palette and a glow, the fading accent. kiln use <theme> switches Ghostty, the edge widget, ap and pages at once. kiln import turns any Ghostty or iTerm2 theme into a new one.

How to use itPalette

01palette

Five steps of ink.One fading accent, three states.

Hierarchy comes from the ink steps, not from colour. The glow marks what matters most and is used once or twice per screen. Green, amber and red only say how something stands.

02type

Mono for structure.Sans for reading.

Headings, labels and numbers are JetBrains Mono at weight 800 with tight tracking; the second line is italic and muted. Labels are small capitals with wide tracking.

06use it

One command to switch.One file per theme.

kiln
$ kiln list                          # themes, ● the one in use
$ kiln use nightsky                  # Ghostty, widget, ap, pages
$ kiln import Dracula --name dracula # any Ghostty or iTerm2 theme
$ kiln build                         # after editing a theme
